title: Comprehensive assessment of 3-benzyloxyflavones as β-glucosidase inhibitors: in vitro, in vivo, kinetic, SAR and computational studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,10484-10500
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08558B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nafeesa Naeem, Ehsan Ullah Mughal
In this study, a series of 3-benzyloxyflavone derivatives (1–10) was designed and, for the first time, evaluated for both in vitro and in vivo inhibitory activity against the β-glucosidase enzyme.
